instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's choice: 'Biru profesional' (professional corporate blue) as the primary brand color.
Theme: iOS-Native Clean (Personality 1), relying on white spaces, clear typography (Plus Jakarta Sans), and subtle borders. Do not make it look muddy or overly dark.
Navigation: Ensure a bottom tab navigator with 4 tabs exactly: Home, Dashboard Absen, Profile, Setting.

Biometric Attendance (Home): Implement built-in phone biometrics (expo-local-authentication) for check-in and check-out. Ensure Geofencing status is displayed on the Hero card (text only: inside/outside area and distance).
History (Dashboard Absen): Use a list view of cards. Each card represents a date with check-in/out times. Add a glass-morphism pinned filter at the top.
Settings: Implement biometric enrollment logic, ensuring it limits to 1 Face and 1 Fingerprint per account. Display '1 Enrolled' / 'Not Enrolled' on the rows. Show 'Logout' prominently.
Ensure the hero images on Login and Profile have a gradient-to-dark scrim pattern to ensure text legibility as per the imagery rules.
